Gold Roman finger ring with inscribed bezel (c. AD 43 - 200). The finger ring has a rectangular-sectioned hoop which widens from a very narrow point to a flat, rectangular bezel. The bezel appears to have been stamped with a rectangular stamp (the outline of which is faintly visible). Incised onto the bezel within the rectangular outline are three initials: G B R. The letters are of unequal size and uncertain execution. The finger ring has been flattened, probably while in the ground, and this has resulted in some fracturing of the hoop at the point where it has been bent.
